baseline_platform_feedback: docs/fts_36228_feedback.json; 36.228 points associated with 243cbcd by submission order, not this candidate

query_microbenchmark.validation: All 500 outputs per group checked against CN8001 / EN11000 / mixed7332 / LIMIT20.

original_sql_benchmark.notes: Unmodified original script and same reused corpus. No build-speed claim; query-only change.

method.process_cpu_clock: Whole-process utime+stime from /proc/PID/stat including background threads; 100 Hz tick resolution.

profiling.workload: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fts_large_bench.docs WHERE MATCH(title_en,content_en) AGAINST('database performance audit');
profiling.caveat: Interrupted GDB snapshots locate paths, not precise CPU percentages. Profiling and timed groups do not overlap.

correctness.native_ps_protocol: Existing extra --ps-protocol failures on both earlier binaries remain unpassed and were not rerun. Normal-protocol SQL PREPARE/EXECUTE is included in passing cases.

adoption_decision.supporting_evidence: CN/EN/mixed median wall improves 5.45%/6.72%/6.03%, process CPU improves 5.08%/7.12%/5.75%; original SQL improves in both pairs for all four query metrics (means 6.86%/6.49%/5.65%/6.14%).
adoption_decision.negative_evidence: Microbenchmark LIMIT wall is 3.09% slower and process CPU is 3.45% slower; original BENG SQL tokenization is 3.08% slower. These samples are retained and not normalized away. No tokenizer or build gain is claimed.

limitations: Only two original-script runs per version; shared host, no exclusive CPU or frequency control.
Original reports print the modified checkout HEAD (2a94c11) for both executables. Use binary paths, SHA-256 checks and source-patch identity rather than printed HEAD/git_dirty for provenance.
CPU ticks include background activity and are especially coarse for short LIMIT queries.
SELECT 1 was 2.66% faster although unchanged; this is evidence of residual environmental variation, not part of the implementation gain.
Do not infer a new platform score from local timings; 36.228 is the prior IK version feedback.
No index build or full reload benchmark was rerun for this query-only implementation.
Previously documented binary-PK projection, native PS protocol and rejected-trial limitations remain in their original records.
